title: Google thinks SpaceX's Starship has to launch 1,800 times before space data centers get off the ground | TechCrunch
summary: Google’s prototype of its orbital compute satellite took off today onboard a SpaceX rocket launched from California — the first time the tech giant has sent one of its advanced chips into space.
